description: This file contains internal testing utilities and frameworks for PyTorch operator check tests, including functions to generate and validate tests for custom operators, manage failure dictionaries, and intercept operator calls during tests.

classes.name: FailuresDict
classes.description: A class managing the loading, saving, and updating of the failures dictionary used to track expected test failures or skips in operator check tests.

classes.name: OpCheckError
classes.description: Custom exception raised during operator check failures.

methods.description: Decorator to mark functions that should not have operator check tests generated for them.

methods.description: Checks if a tensor is considered abstract (not concretely materialized).

methods.description: Wraps schema check on an operator, handling tensor copying and abstract checks.

methods.name: None safe_autograd_registration_check( op: torch._ops.OpOverload, args: tuple[Any, ...], kwargs: dict[str, Any], *, copy_inputs: bool = True, rtol: Optional[float] = None, atol: Optional[float] = None, )
methods.description: Performs autograd registration check safely, considering tensor properties.

methods.name: Any deepcopy_tensors(inputs: Any)

methods.name: None generate_opcheck_tests( testcase: Any, namespaces: list[str], failures_dict_path: Optional[str] = None, additional_decorators: Optional[dict[str, Callable]] = None, test_utils: list[str] = DEFAULT_TEST_UTILS, )
methods.description: Main function to generate additional operator check tests for a given TestCase, based on existing test methods, operator namespaces, and failure dictionary.

methods.name: generate_tag_tests(testcase, failures_dict, additional_decorators)
methods.description: Generates specific tag-based tests for operator compliance and correctness.

methods.description: Checks environment variable to determine if failures dict should be forcibly updated.

methods.name: is_inside_opcheck_mode()
methods.description: Checks if currently inside operator check mode.

methods.name: OpCheckMode
methods.description: Context manager class that intercepts operator calls during tests, checks for expected failures, and manages error collection, also handling environment setup for tests.

methods.name: None should_print_better_repro()
methods.description: Controls whether to print detailed repro commands on test failures, based on environment variable.
